title: NextLongIso pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for multi-dimensional long-read RNA-seq analysis (isoforms, splicing, APA, promoters and transposable elements)

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Samplesheet, reference files and output directory.

samplesheet.description: Samplesheet CSV with columns sample,condition and fastq (or bam for --input_type bam).
samplesheet.help_text: Sample and condition names must match ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ (letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter). See the Samplesheet section of the README.

input_type.description: Input data type. 'fastq' aligns reads with minimap2; 'bam' starts from coordinate-sorted BAM files.

genome.description: Genome FASTA (uncompressed). Required for both input types (used by minimap2 and Bambu).

gtf.description: Reference annotation GTF (uncompressed), from the same assembly and with the same chromosome names as --genome.

te_gtf.description: Optional transposable-element GTF (TEtranscripts format). Enables the TE analysis.

publish_dir_mode.description: How result files are published to --outdir.

alignment_options.title: Alignment options (minimap2)
alignment_options.description: Options for FASTQ input. Ignored with --input_type bam.

minimap2_preset.description: minimap2 preset (-x/-ax). Use 'splice:hq' for PacBio Iso-Seq or other high-accuracy reads.

minimap2_args.description: Extra minimap2 alignment options, appended after the defaults (e.g. --minimap2_args="-G 500k").
minimap2_args.help_text: Appended after -ax <preset> -t <cpus> [--junc-bed] --secondary=no, so later options override earlier ones. Index-building options (-k, -w, -H) have no effect here; use --minimap2_index_args.

minimap2_junc_bed.description: Guide spliced alignment with junctions from --gtf (--junc-bed).

minimap2_index.description: Pre-built minimap2 index (.mmi). Skips index building. Must be built from --genome with the same preset.

minimap2_index_args.description: Extra options for building the minimap2 index (e.g. -k, -w, -H). Ignored when --minimap2_index is given.

resource_options.title: Resource limits
resource_options.description: Upper limits for any single task. Requests above these values are capped.

hpc_options.title: HPC options
hpc_options.description: Used by the slurm and lsf profiles (e.g. -profile singularity,lsf).

hpc_cluster_options.description: Extra scheduler options, e.g. --hpc_cluster_options="-G compute-<group>" for LSF at WashU RIS.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix for the execution report files in <outdir>/pipeline_info (default: launch timestamp).
